name: Foundation Grid Views Style
description: Views style plugin that renders results using the ZURB Foundation XY grid, with responsive small/medium/large cell sizing, gutters, orientation, and tokenizable custom cell classes.
project_description:
Provides a ZURB Foundation Grid views style plugin with settings like:

 
 Columns / Cells: Small, Medium, Large (1-12 + auto + none) 
 Grid Gutter settings 
 Margin / Padding Grid setting 
 And other typical Drupal grid settings. 
 
 Supported grid systems: 

 
 XY-Grid 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Views (Drupal Core) 
 Foundation Sites (library)
